Radio.radioConsoleIntro: Talk on the CAD's radio channels from any browser. Players in FiveM hear you on their radios.
Radio.radioDisabledMessage: An admin can turn it on in CAD Settings > Features > Radio.
Radio.enableAudio: Click to turn on radio audio
Radio.noChannels: There are no radio channels you can use yet.
Radio.pickChannel: Pick a channel to talk on
Radio.selectTransmit: Join this channel to talk on it
Radio.httpsNote: Talking needs the CAD to be opened over HTTPS (or on localhost): browsers only give microphone access to secure pages. Listening works everywhere.
Radio.popOut: Pop out the radio into its own window
Radio.enableAudioElsewhere: Click the radio in the window that plays the audio (the pop-out, or your first CAD tab) to turn on sound
Radio.anyPageNote: The radio stays on every page of the CAD and in every CAD tab. Your push-to-talk key works on any page; with several tabs or the pop-out open, only one of them plays the audio.
Radio.channelsHint: Headphones: listen to a channel · Talk: the channel you transmit on
Radio.listeningCount: Listening to {count, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}}
Radio.adminIntro: Radio channels everyone with the CAD can talk on: dispatchers in the browser, units on the LEO and EMS-FD pages, and players in FiveM.
Radio.audioServerIntro: How radio audio travels. Push-to-talk, talking indicators and channel changes always go through the CAD.
Radio.builtinDescription: Audio goes through the CAD's own API. Nothing else to install; good for dozens of people on the radio.
Radio.livekitDescription: Audio goes through your LiveKit server ({url}). Better quality and scales to hundreds of people.
Radio.livekitNotConfigured: Set RADIO_LIVEKIT_URL, RADIO_LIVEKIT_API_KEY and RADIO_LIVEKIT_API_SECRET in the CAD's .env and restart it to use a LiveKit server.
Radio.livekitFallbackTitle: Using the built-in audio for now
Radio.livekitFallback: LiveKit is selected, but its settings are missing from the CAD's .env.
Radio.integrationsHint: FiveM and other radios connect with the CAD API token (CAD Settings > API Token). See the radio docs for the FiveM resource and the integration guide.
Radio.departmentsDescription: Leave empty for everyone with radio access. Dispatchers can always use every channel.
Radio.allowExternalDescription: Game servers and other radios can put people on this channel even when they have no CAD account. When off, only CAD users can join, and nearby players can't overhear it.
Radio.receiveOnlyDescription: Units can listen but only dispatchers can talk (e.g. an announcements channel).
Radio.noChannelsAdmin: No radio channels yet. Add one above.
